fluff.overview: The Phantom was pushed into production by Khan Phelan Ward shortly before the Refusal War between Clan Wolf and Clan Jade Falcon, designed around Khan Ward's extensive experience with Inner Sphere tactics.
fluff.capabilities: Intended to push a medium reconnaissance 'Mech to the most extreme limits, the Phantom is built on a lightweight Type-A Endo Steel chassis and is propelled to a top speed of 151.2 km/h by a Light Force 360 XL Engine. The Phantom also boasts strong protection for its size with six tons of Composite A-2 Ferro-Fibrous armor.
fluff.deployment: The F configuration carries an ER Medium Laser in each side torso, supported by a Heavy Medium Laser in the right arm. Anti-infantry support comes from a Heavy Flamer in the left arm, while an ECM Suite in the center torso jams enemy sensors.
fluff.history: After the Wars of Reaving, the Phantom replaced the Fire Moth Omnimech for the remaining Home Clans because of its similar role and heavier profile.
